title: matched-filter rise-shape timing versus waveform ML time-walk closure

pre_registered.reproduction: exact S00 selected B-stave pulse count from raw h101/HRDv ROOT
pre_registered.split: leave one Sample-II analysis run out; train correction models on all other Sample-II analysis runs
pre_registered.traditional_method: matched-filter plus constant-fraction/template time-walk correction using run-excluded pulse-shape bins
pre_registered.win_rule: lowest held-out paired-bootstrap sigma68_ns among correction methods; ties break by lower |residual|>0.5 ns tail and then lower absolute bias

next_tickets.title: S54b: external clock or trigger-reference validation for waveform time-walk closure
next_tickets.body: Repeat the S54a matched-filter and waveform-ML timing panel against an external clock/trigger reference rather than same-event downstream-pair residuals. Expected information gain: separates true absolute timing improvement from pair-symmetry corrections that may cancel common-mode errors.
